title: Ottawa launches $2B rebate program for heat pump owners. But are they worth it? | Hanomansing Live
summary: A CBC segment on Ottawa's 2023 heat pump rebate of up to $10,000 for oil-heated homes; a NAIT instructor says modern heat pumps heat Edmonton homes to about -30°C with backup below that.

assertions.quote: The rebate for households that switch to heat pumps is up to $10,000.

verdicts.note: Canada's Oil to Heat Pump Affordability program offered up to $10,000 to eligible oil-heated households, with provincial top-ups in some regions.
The federal Oil to Heat Pump Affordability Program pays up to $10,000 upfront for cold-climate air-source heat pumps (as of 2023; landlords and renters ineligible).
